Loading the libraries
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
```
Loading the data
```{r}
COG_anno = read_delim("description_mapfiles/COG_cat.txt",delim = "\t",col_names = FALSE)
COG_cat_anno = read_delim("description_mapfiles/translate_COG_cat_anno.txt",delim = "\t",col_names = FALSE)
COG_cat_anno = as.data.frame(COG_cat_anno)
COG_anno = as.data.frame(COG_anno)
rownames(COG_anno) = COG_anno[,1]
COG_anno = COG_anno[,-1]
names(COG_anno) = c("COG_letter","COG_description")
names(COG_cat_anno) = c("COG_letter","COG_category")
COG_anno$COG_letter = substr(COG_anno$COG_letter, 1, 1)
COG_anno = dplyr::select(COG_anno,COG_letter,COG_description)
COG_anno_cat = left_join(COG_anno,COG_cat_anno,by = "COG_letter")
rownames(COG_anno_cat) = rownames(COG_anno)
write_rds(COG_anno_cat,"description_mapfiles/COG_anno.rds")
```

```{r}
col_COG = read_delim("description_mapfiles/cog-24.fun.tab.txt",delim = "\t",col_names = FALSE)
col_COG = col_COG[,1:2]
col_COG = as.data.frame(col_COG)
rownames(col_COG) = col_COG[,1]
col_COG_a = c(col_COG[,2])
names(col_COG_a) = col_COG[,1]
```
